Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: NEW reaction animation poses for an existing 2D pixel survival enemy. The input sheet is a DESIGN AND CAMERA reference. Preserve exact monster identity, outfit, fungal growths, palette, pixel-art rendering and facing angle. Do NOT reuse its locomotion or attack poses.
OUTPUT 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Exact 6 columns by 4 rows, 24 isolated full-body poses, equal 256x256 cells. No grid lines or labels. Each figure at most 170px wide by 180px high with at least 30px empty transparent padding at every edge. Same size and common feet anchor (128,215) inside every cell. Every limb fits entirely inside the cell. Fixed slightly overhead game camera; no rotation to a different facing direction.
ROW 1, HURT, six frames LEFT TO RIGHT: neutral ready; sudden impact with head/shoulders jerking back; maximum torso flinch with arms pulled toward hurt area; recoil settling; regain posture; near neutral. One-shot small reaction. Real articulated posture changes, not six identical sprites shifted.
ROW 2, STUNNED, six looping frames: slack off-balance posture with drooping arms/head; slight sway to one side; head lolls and shoulders sink; sway through center; slight sway to opposite side; return toward first slack pose. Clearly dazed/different from idle breathing. Feet stay planted. No stars, symbols, flashing, halo or particles.
ROW 3, KNOCKBACK, six frames: brace at impact; strong backward torso lean with both arms flailing; one foot lifted as balance is lost; backward catch-step with legs clearly changing; regain balance in crouch; recovery ready. Much stronger than hurt. Remain standing, no death, no prone body. For heavy creatures use a heavy stagger, not weightless flight. Keep motion in place; world displacement will be handled by game physics, do not shift creature across cell.
ROW 4, SCALE REFERENCE ONLY: six identical neutral standing poses from the supplied design, with the same size and anchor as the top three rows. This calibration row is intentionally static and will not be exported as an animation.
Hard crisp pixel clusters, no painting, no 3D, no motion blur, no ground shadows, no glow, no scenery, no text, no weapon or other actor, no gore. Genuine RGBA transparency around each figure. Strong readable silhouettes at small game scale.

MONSTER: Thin bald infected in torn olive jacket, gray trousers, small orange fungal patches. Sharp human-sized reactions, arms recoil.
MANDATORY FACING: Facing SOUTH/down toward viewer; front of torso visible.
